sources.title: vit-age-classifier: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview vit-age-classifier is a Vision Transformer fine-tuned specifically to classify the apparent age of a person's face in images. Built and maintained by nateraw, this model leverages the transformer architecture for image classification using the Hugging Face transformers library. The model uses ViTFeatureExtractor for preprocessing and ViTForImageClassification as its core architecture ...
